sentences.text: 1. The accused/applicant seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 63/2023 of Police Station Special Cell for offence under Section 406/420/120B/34 of IPC.
1.1. This bail application came up for the first hearing on 20.01.2025 before the predecessor bench and thereafter continued getting adjourned before different benches.
Along with 179 such old pending bail applications, this application also was transferred to this bench.
1.2 Today is the first hearing before me.
2. As requested by learned counsel for the accused/applicant, matter is passed over.
In this second call, learned counsel for accused/applicant submits that This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 30/03/2026 at 22:44:32 he has instructions, so seeks permission to withdraw this bail application with liberty to file afresh before the trial court since there has been change in circumstances.
4. As requested, the bail application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought.
